caption:
Trump says he asked Putin to pull back all military aggression against Europe

Donald Trump · World

He said he made the request when they met in China last week and thinks it would help lead to a deal on Ukraine. His comments came a day after he hosted Nato chief Mark Rutte in Florida.

Reported by South China Morning Post; France 24; The Japan Times.
